description: This source file defines the Tabs6 class, extending TabActivity, which creates a tabbed interface with three tabs, each displaying simple text content. It implements TabHost.TabContentFactory to generate content for each tab dynamically.

classes.name: Tabs6
classes.description: Main activity class that sets up a tabbed interface with three tabs, each displaying a simple TextView as content, and handles tab content creation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and adds three tabs to the TabHost.

methods.name: createTabContent
methods.description: Creates a TextView with content indicating the tab's tag, used as tab content.
